Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: CrowdFix
Description:
Cuts per-frame engine overhead that causes stutter and low FPS, most noticeable in crowded areas.
Skips idle GPU resource notifiers, chains job worker wake-ups, drops repeated skeleton pose syncs, trims the culling visibility clear and shortens the graphics allocator lock.
Each fix can be toggled via /crowdfix
Punchline: Smoother frame times by cutting engine overhead.

Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: UpscaleBuddy
Description:
Runs temporal upscaling and anti-aliasing through the game's own DLSS path.
Built-in FSR 3.1 works on any GPU; AMD's FSR DLL over D3D12 adds FSR 4 where the GPU and driver support it, and Intel's XeSS runs over D3D12 too.
Supports the quality presets and Native AA.
Frame generation doubles the shown frame rate with AMD's FSR frame generation, keeping the game UI and nameplates out of the generated frames.
A low latency frame limiter replaces the game's 60/30 fps limit.
Open the settings with /upscalebuddy
Punchline: FSR 3.1, FSR 4 and XeSS upscaling, anti-aliasing and frame generation.

Author: SheepGoMeh
Name: BlurBuddy
Description:
A streamer's best friend: becomes OBS's Game Capture source and sends the game without UI, with nameplates only, or with all game UI, with nameplates and chosen windows blurred. Your own screen is never changed.
Open the settings with /blurbuddy
Punchline: Blur game UI on stream, not on your screen.

Author: Raine Aeternal
Name: Ukeire
Description:
Ukeire watches your Doman Mahjong table and helps you learn Riichi strategy.
It shows shanten and tile acceptance, reviews each discard after you make it, warns about dangerous tiles when an opponent is in riichi, and points out yaku you can aim for.
Hints come in tiers (nudge, pointer, answer) and only appear when you ask. The plugin never clicks, discards or calls for you, and it only reads what you can already see at the table.
Punchline: A Doman Mahjong tutor: hand analysis, reviews and hints that never play for you.
